scope: Max-level PvE guide baseline; not personalized optimization.

stat_guidance.single_target: Weapon Damage > Agility > Mastery > Haste >= Crit > Versatility.
stat_guidance.aoe: Weapon Damage > Agility > Mastery > Crit > Versatility = Haste.

conditions: Liquid Luster: use six seconds before the pull. Potion of Recklessness is an alternative when Mastery is highest.
Flask of the Magisters (Mastery) is the other listed flask option.
Food: the guide lists Harandar Celebration and Silvermoon Parade as feasts, with Hearty Royal Roast as the personal food.
The guide writes the single-target Haste/Crit order as "Haste => Crit"; treated as Haste at least equal to Crit.
Guide stat overview says three secondary stats are currently better than Agility, which contradicts its ranking; simulate gear rather than assuming fixed weights.
unresolved: Exact quality ranks, item effects, durations and shared cooldowns require tooltip verification.
validation_scope: Current guide recommendations and linked identities only; unknown item mechanics are not assumed.
